title: The Child in the Well
text: A thin voice rises from a dry well, asking for its mother, asking over and over in the same small words. The rope is still tied off at the top, grey and furred with age. Nobody has drawn water here for a hundred years, and the voice has not grown any older.

options.label: The healer hauls on the old rope, hoping the voice is what it sounds like.

outcomes.text: It is a real child, starved and silent, who will not let go of the healer's hand. They bring the child home, where it never once speaks of the well.
Something comes up the rope that is shaped like a child only for as long as someone is looking at it.

options.label: Leave it. No child could have lived down there so long.

outcomes.text: The voice follows you for a mile. Then it stops asking for its mother and begins calling your names instead.

options.label: Drop a torch down the well, and listen for whatever answers.

outcomes.text: No scream rises. The torch falls for far too long, its light dwindling to nothing without ever meeting a bottom.
